en:
## New Features

- Add PostgreSQL dual-backend foundation: runtime client, migrations, port/adapter storage, mailbox/publication, and safety gates for endpoints that are not fully migrated yet.
- Introduce structural editing tools (StructView / StructSed) with grammar-aware highlighting, stash mode, and render support.
- Extend Git management to local and remote workdir narrators, with unified workspace resolution and permission isolation.
- Support Kimi quota reset-window waiting, routine tool modes (manual/auto/resident), NUG client CONNECT tunneling, and more robust Codex auth callbacks.
- Add a global image viewer, Markdown preview scroll sync, and workspace barrier status cards in settings.

## Bug Fixes

- Repaint virtual-list compact progress from a render-time store instead of layout rebuilds, and clean up COW replacement identities correctly.
- Align narrator live geometry with typography and publish partial assistant content with parent-aware versioning.
- Fix interrupt send ordering, interaction-area resize handles, and Git change-list double counting.
- Improve agent Git status refresh, reflection prompts, and interrupt-guard structured bodies.
- Fix structural-tool remaining issues, Git workspace capacity checks, and remote file-operation boundaries.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 落地 PostgreSQL 双后端基础：运行时连接池、迁移资产、Port/Adapter 领域存储、Mailbox/Publication，以及尚未完整迁移端点的安全门禁。
- 引入结构化编辑工具（StructView / StructSed），支持语法感知高亮、stash 模式与卡片渲染。
- Git 管理扩展到本机与远程工作目录叙述者，统一工作区解析与权限隔离。
- 支持 Kimi 配额重置窗口等待、例程工具三态模式（manual/auto/resident）、NUG 客户端 CONNECT 隧道，并增强 Codex 授权回调容错。
- 新增全局图片查看器、Markdown 预览滚动同步，以及设置页工作区屏障状态卡片。

## 修复

- 虚拟列表压缩进度改由渲染态 store 局部重绘，不再触发布局 rebuild，并正确清理 COW 替换身份。
- 对齐叙述者实时几何与字体设置，分段发布未完成的助手内容时采用父消息感知的版本策略。
- 修复中断发送顺序、交互区底部间距拖拽，以及 Git 变更列表重复计数。
- 改进 Agent 的 Git 状态刷新、Reflection 提示与中断守卫结构化 body。
- 修复结构化工具遗留问题、Git 工作区授权容量判断与远程文件操作边界。
